metadata.description: Native WebSocket settings grouped to keep the shared ARM template below the 256-parameter limit. Enable only after validating prerequisites.
Required when enabled: Key Vault app-setting reference resolving to a random bridge secret of at least 32 characters.

appSettings.name: DatadogTags
appSettings.value: [concat(parameters('DataDog').Tags, if(empty(parameters('DataDog').Tags), '', ','), 'cloud_provider:azure,subscription_id:', subscription().subscriptionId, ',resource_group:', resourceGroup().name, ',name:', parameters('FunctionAppName'), ',type:microsoft.web/sites,resource_id:', resourceId('Microsoft.Web/sites', parameters('FunctionAppName')))]
